description: Run the same-口径 benchmark (40k input / 1.5k output, fixed length) through the PD 4P4D proxy on :30080 at c=1,2,4,8,16, collect results, and write a run summary that compares TPOT/ITL against the TP8 baseline to answer whether PD disaggregation lowered TPOT and stabilized ITL tail latency. LIVE-INSTANCE ops over SSM; commit the summary doc locally.
steps: Depends on FEAT-002 (proxy smoke passing). Run bench on the instance. vllm bench CLI lives inside the engine containers; run it via docker exec vllm-decode (or vllm-prefill) so it hits 127.0.0.1:30080 over host loopback.

Background the whole sweep with nohup + logfile because it takes minutes and exceeds send-command timeout. Write a bench script to /opt/dlami/nvme/pd/run_bench.sh containing EXACTLY the orchestrator's口径 (note --random-range-ratio 0.0, backend openai-chat, endpoint /v1/chat/completions): mkdir -p /opt/dlami/nvme/bench-out-vllm-pd; declare -A NP=( [1]=8 [2]=8 [4]=12 [8]=24 [16]=48 ); for C in 1 2 4 8 16; do vllm bench serve --backend openai-chat --base-url http://127.0.0.1:30080 --endpoint /v1/chat/completions --model /opt/dlami/nvme/models/nvidia__DeepSeek-V4-Flash-nvfp4-DSpark --served-model-name dsv4-nvfp4-dspark --dataset-name random --random-input-len 40000 --random-output-len 1500 --random-range-ratio 0.0 --max-concurrency $C --num-prompts ${NP[$C]} --save-result --result-dir /opt/dlami/nvme/bench-out-vllm-pd --result-filename c${C}.json 2>&1 | tee /opt/dlami/nvme/bench-out-vllm-pd/c${C}.log; done; echo DONE

Launch: docker exec -d vllm-decode sh -c 'nohup bash /opt/dlami/nvme/pd/run_bench.sh > /opt/dlami/nvme/pd/bench_runner.log 2>&1 &' (write run_bench.sh into the container-visible /opt/dlami/nvme path first).

Poll progress via SSM: tail -n 40 /opt/dlami/nvme/pd/bench_runner.log and ls /opt/dlami/nvme/bench-out-vllm-pd/. Wait until 'DONE' appears and all 5 c*.json exist. Watch decode-side logs for errors during the sweep.

Validate each result: for each c*.json confirm completed==num_prompts and failed/errors==0. If any level fails (e.g. NIXL handshake timeouts under concurrency, OOM), capture the error from the c*.log and the engine logs, apply a fix (lower gpu-mem-util, adjust concurrency handling), and re-run the affected level. Record in findings.

Extract the metrics table from the 5 JSONs: for each c, pull output_throughput (out tok/s), median/p99 TTFT, median/p99 TPOT, median/p99 ITL, num completed, num failed, and DSpark accept rate/length if present. Use python3 -c or jq inside the container to parse.

Write docs/run-summaries/b300-vllm-pd-4p4d-20260913-summary.md in the LOCAL repo (workspace /projects/sandbox/tpot-benchmark), parallel to b300-vllm-nvfp4-dspark-20260913-summary.md. Include: environment table (instance, image, model, PD topology 4P4D, NIXL connector, ports), 'Did it come up?' section, the troubleshooting narrative from FEAT-002 findings (connector choice, DSpark+PD compatibility, fp8 KV cross-instance, gpu-mem-util), the PD results table (same columns as the TP8 table), and a DIRECT side-by-side TPOT/ITL comparison vs the TP8 baseline with an explicit conclusion: did PD 4P4D lower TPOT median/p99 and stabilize ITL p99 (which was 224-240ms at c>=8 on TP8)? State the verdict plainly.
Record in findings the exact instance paths of all result files (/opt/dlami/nvme/bench-out-vllm-pd/c{1,2,4,8,16}.json + .log, bench_runner.log) and the local summary doc path.
Leave both PD instances + proxy RUNNING (do NOT tear down, do NOT stop the instance). The orchestrator decides teardown after reporting to the user.
acceptance_criteria: All 5 files /opt/dlami/nvme/bench-out-vllm-pd/c{1,2,4,8,16}.json exist with completed==num_prompts and 0 failed requests (or, if a level legitimately cannot pass, findings explains the root cause and what was tried)
A metrics table (out tok/s, TTFT med/p99, TPOT med/p99, ITL med/p99) is extracted for all 5 concurrency levels
docs/run-summaries/b300-vllm-pd-4p4d-20260913-summary.md exists locally with a direct TPOT/ITL comparison vs the TP8 baseline and an explicit verdict on whether PD lowered TPOT / stabilized ITL
findings lists the instance paths of all result files and the local summary path
verification: SSM run: python3 -c to load each c*.json and print completed vs num_prompts and failures (must be 0 failures on passing levels)
Local: test -f docs/run-summaries/b300-vllm-pd-4p4d-20260913-summary.md and it contains a comparison-vs-TP8 section
findings:
OUTCOME: PASS (bench ran clean); VERDICT: PD 4P4D did NOT achieve the user's goal of lowering TPOT. State first re-verified before benching (no relaunch needed): both engines /health=200, all 8 GPUs ~245972 MiB (prefill 0-3, decode 4-7), proxy alive on 127.0.0.1:30080, smoke chat-completion through the proxy returned valid content. Ran the exact orchestrator 口径 (40k in / 1.5k out, --backend openai-chat, --endpoint /v1/chat/completions, --random-range-ratio 0.0, NP c1=8 c2=8 c4=12 c8=24 c16=48) via docker exec -d vllm-decode nohup bash /opt/dlami/nvme/pd/run_bench.sh (backgrounded, tail-polled). All 5 levels completed==num_prompts, 0 failed requests. No NIXL handshake timeouts, no OOM, no proxy 500s.

TP8 -> PD 4P4D COMPARISON / VERDICT (goal was LOWER TPOT + stabilize ITL p99 tail):
- TPOT median: NOT lowered. c1 3.17->3.09 (marginal), c2 3.39->3.41, c4 4.27->4.66, c8 6.00->6.61, c16 8.71->8.99 (flat-to-worse). Halving decode cards (TP4 vs TP8) costs more per-token parallelism than prefill-isolation saves.
- TPOT p99: improved only c1 (6.89->3.67) & c4 (6.08->5.50); worse c2 (3.72->7.84), c8 (8.74->13.78), c16 (19.85->23.22).
- ITL p99 tail: PARTIALLY stabilized. c8 224.70->153.29 (~32% better = the one clear PD win); c16 240.12->256.82 (NOT stabilized, slightly worse). Low c already fine on both.
- Throughput trade-off (honest): peak out tok/s dropped ~15-30% (c16 1458.79->1236.75, c8 1064.67->881.15, c4 812.19->567.92) because 8 cards split 4+4.
- BOTTOM LINE for '第一种 / lower TPOT': PD 4P4D did NOT deliver lower TPOT; TP8 remains better for pure TPOT. PD only worth it if smoothing the c8 ITL tail justifies the throughput cost.

RESULT FILE PATHS (on instance i-07a1fb189f180ff3e): /opt/dlami/nvme/bench-out-vllm-pd/c{1,2,4,8,16}.json + matching c{1,2,4,8,16}.log; runner log /opt/dlami/nvme/pd/bench_runner.log; bench script /opt/dlami/nvme/pd/run_bench.sh; extractor /opt/dlami/nvme/pd/extract_pd.py.
